Definition: meaning one skilled in law; a judge
BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word names a judge or interpreter of the law, one skilled in the decrees. Nebuchadnezzar summons his judges and counsellors when the golden image is set up, and they gather to watch the three friends walk out of the furnace unharmed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the judges of Babylon are a picture of every power that serves a king's image instead of the truth; they stood by while faithful men were thrown into the fire, and the fire itself proved whose law stands.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
